russia_status.claim: No conclusion about presence or absence of a Russia factor; all Russia variables failed the measurement-coverage stage, rather than an empirical test of the factor.

methodological_assessment.q2: Compact working summary: state-course support/basic-goods access/admin implementation and programmatic renewal/problem disclosure. Both axes are heavily anchored by a single near-unit loading; the second has only two strong descriptors. It omits the values/prevention structure. A heuristic parsimonious recommendation, not validated truth.
methodological_assessment.q3: Conditional primary interpretive candidate: adds a values/memory/continuity direction with opposite association to preventive preparation. Support/basic-goods/admin and renewal/problem-disclosure directions remain. More informative than q2, but near-unit single indicators, small n and bootstrap fragility require caution.
methodological_assessment.q4: Exploratory refinement: separates preventive preparation from values/continuity. The extra resolution has nominal df=2 with 34 parameters and 36 covariance moments, two factors with only two strong descriptors, and near-unit single indicators. Larger total common variance is not alone a reason to select q4.
methodological_assessment.dimension_rule: df is a necessary parameter-count condition, not sufficient identification. Three overlapping held-out splits and SDs are not independent validation or significance tests. Permutation PCA retains three components by small margins; it is a geometric diagnostic, not FA factor confirmation.
methodological_assessment.recommended_use: If retaining the assistant-reviewed measurements as a conditional exploratory corpus, show q2 and q3 side by side and provisionally discuss q3 for semantic coverage. Do not claim source-robust validated structure: removing flagged observations fails the existing minimum-variable policy.
methodological_assessment.source_validation: No fresh external source validation is performed in this numeric audit. Previously recorded source_audit flags and completion provenance are used as-is.
methodological_assessment.label_note: A negative loading for a unipolar property means lower measured expression at the positive end of the factor, not expression of an unmeasured antonym. The generated phrase Обратная связь is an ambiguous sign label; it must not be read as a psychological feedback mechanism.
